entries.name: UCUM unit definitions
entries.versionBasis: Observed XML root version and revision-date; publisher artifact guide also identifies 2.2. Mutable main needs a pin before acquisition.

licence.basis: Unchanged copies may be distributed under the UCUM licence with notices and attribution. entries.notes: Licence page heading identifies version 1.1 (June 2024), while its introductory acceptance text still says version 1.0. Preserve the selected notice rather than silently normalizing that discrepancy. Redistribution: license-conditions.
